name: grok-viral-3d-artisan-gelato-mcp-suite
target_market_value: \$1000 USD High-Converting WebGL Artisan Gelato Experience
description: Production-ready master MCP client configuration and creative developer instruction set for Grok to architect, generate, and animate ultra-viral 3D Ice Cream Store websites using React Three Fiber, GLSL melting cream shaders, Pexels API media integration, Motion Anything repository bindings, and GLB model transformations with open-source fallbacks.

pexels-media-engine.description: Exposes tool endpoints for searching and loading 4K ice cream photography, macro dessert videos, and vibrant background clips into R3F canvas planes using the integrated API key.

motion-anything-engine.description: Integrates the nexu-io Motion Anything pipeline to auto-generate dynamic motion vector fields, automated object animations, and generative particle motions.

open-source-media-engine.description: Provides local & open-source public CDN assets for loading backup gourmet ice cream visuals and looping video elements directly when offline or bypassing external API limits.

r3f-declarative-builder.description: Generates declaratively structured R3F canvas scenes, perspective camera rigs, soft warm lighting, and responsive viewports.

gltf-to-jsx-pipeline.description: Parses 3D ice cream GLB models (e.g., waffle cones, gelato scoops, sundaes, toppings) into optimized R3F JSX components with subsurface scattering and transmission materials.

glsl-fluid-melt-synthesizer.description: Compiles and injects custom liquid swirl/melt vertex and fragment shaders, cream distortion planes, and interactive fluid mouse ripples.

motion-design-bridge.description: Manages animated soft-sprinkle HUD overlays, kinetic typography badges, floating ingredient particles, and elastic spring UI interactions.

gltf-draco-optimizer.description: Executes local headless Draco compression, mesh simplification, and Basis Universal texture encoding on GLB models to maintain 60FPS performance.

design_system_and_palettes.design_philosophy: Gourmet Tactile Softness — Organic curved geometry, soft-touch glassmorphism, subsurface light dispersion, and fluid melting physics paired with high-contrast typography.

typography.display_headers: Playful Serif / Soft Curved Geometry (e.g., Recoleta / Grand Slang)
typography.body_and_ui: Clean Sans-Serif (e.g., Plus Jakarta Sans / Inter)

core_tech_stack.framework: React 18 / Next.js App Router or Vite + React
core_tech_stack.animation_engine: Motion Anything (https://github.com/nexu-io/motion-anything.git) + GSAP (ScrollTrigger, quickTo) + Framer Motion 3D
core_tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS (Theme: Warm Cream / Pastel Pink / Soft Mint / Dark Cocoa)
core_tech_stack.texture_engine: Pexels API Video/Photo Textures + Procedural GLSL Shaders

hero_section.canvas_setup: Full-screen fixed R3F canvas overlaying warm cream DOM background.
hero_section.centerpiece_3d_model: Interactive floating GLB Model (Artisan Gelato Cone with dynamic toppings) configured with MeshPhysicalMaterial, subsurface scattering, and soft clearcoat gloss.
hero_section.liquid_background: Curved WebGL mesh plane rendering a 4K Pexels dessert video texture masked with a procedural swirling cream/berry GLSL liquid shader that drips and ripples dynamically on mouse movement.
hero_section.custom_cursor: Spring-physics soft scoop/sprinkle particle cursor driving `uMouse` and `uVelocity` raycasted uniforms onto the canvas plane.

feature_scroll_trigger.interaction: As user scrolls via Lenis, Motion Anything motion dynamics and GSAP ScrollTrigger lerp the 3D Gelato cone position, rotating it 360-degrees while dropping dynamic 3D sprinkles and berries.
feature_scroll_trigger.hud_overlays: Floating 3D glassmorphic badges ('100% ORGANIC MILK', 'HAND-CRAFTED DAILY', 'ZERO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS') with soft drop shadows.

flavor_3d_showcase.gallery_style: Curved 3D Carousel composed of R3F interactive flavor scoops (e.g., Pistachio, Wild Berry, Dark Chocolate Fudge, Mango Sorbet) wrapped with high-resolution Pexels photo textures.
flavor_3d_showcase.glassmorphism: drei `<MeshTransmissionMaterial />` creating realistic condensed ice glass refraction over floating flavor ingredients.

call_to_action.post_processing_flare: Triggers warm Bloom (intensity=1.2) and subtle Depth of Field blur when hovering over the 'Order Fresh Tub Now' CTA button.

effects.purpose: Enhances soft highlights on glossy syrup glaze, fresh berries, and whipped cream.
Creates cinematic commercial macro camera depth when focusing on key flavor scoops.
Softly draws user focus toward the centered 3D hero gelato model.

system_instructions_for_grok: You are an elite Creative Technologist and WebGL Lead Developer building a premium, high-converting \$1,000 interactive 3D Artisan Ice Cream & Gelato website.
ALWAYS structure code using React Three Fiber (R3F), `@react-three/drei`, and `@react-three/postprocessing` in clean JSX syntax.

Inject the Pexels API key (`wNw2FWSSVyJMjjzuV2s9BRkqdyKJBaK7JycHOUUuNyA78Ksftx06FVzt`) to fetch high-resolution dessert imagery and 4K media textures into `useVideoTexture` and `useTexture` components.
Integrate animation patterns from `https://github.com/nexu-io/motion-anything.git` for realistic fluid and particle motion orchestration.
Apply high-end material properties (`MeshPhysicalMaterial`, `MeshTransmissionMaterial`, and subsurface light scatter) to render realistic cream, syrup glazes, ice crystals, and waffle textures.
Implement soft melting/swirling cursor interactions by raycasting mouse screen coordinates to a WebGL canvas plane running custom fluid displacement shaders.
Synchronize Lenis smooth scroll with GSAP ScrollTrigger to smoothly control 3D camera zoom, pitch, and flavor rotation across all site sections.
